chunks: And if you die or are killed, surely to God you will be gathered.
ai.seo_question: What happens to believers after they die or are killed in battle?
ai.summary: In the context of the Battle of Uhud, this verse reassures the believers that martyrdom is not a loss but a transition to the divine presence, reinforcing the concept of *hushr* (gathering) for accountability. Shia scholarship often highlights this as a confirmation of the physical resurrection and the continuity of the soul's journey toward God, regardless of the manner of death.
